description: Surfaces that the UI/UX scoring programme must capture. Derived from the App Router tree (src/app/**/page.tsx) and the workspace registry (GITHUB_PROJECT_WORKSPACE_MAPPINGS in src/lib/github-project-sync.ts). Verified by scripts/derive-captured-surfaces.ts, which fails when the app serves a route this file does not list, when a capture decision is missing or unrecognised, when an exclusion is unjustified or unattributed, and when a 'required' surface has never actually been captured. See mission-control-kanban#142 and #144.

captureContract.required: The surface is in the scoring programme. It must carry a 'capturedAt' record naming the 40-hex commit measured, the ISO date, the viewport labels covered, and the method used -- or an explicit 'captureDeferred' with a substantive reason and a tracking issue. 'required' with neither is a NON-passing state: the surface is unmeasured, not known-good.
captureContract.excluded: The surface is deliberately outside the programme. It must carry a substantive 'reason' (>= 20 chars, no placeholders) and an 'excludedBy' tracking reference (#issue, URL, or 40-hex commit) so the downgrade is attributable and reviewable.
captureContract.capture: npm run surfaces:probe -- measures element-level clipping. Document scroll is NOT a valid measurement here: src/app/globals.css clamps html/body with max-width:100vw and overflow-x:hidden, so an overflowing page reports zero document scroll.
